description.en: Rebuilds the character the player controls with another body (kit) number: it deletes the current one (CMND_DELETE_CHARA on the GET_HANDLE_TYPE_CTRL_PC handle), creates it again with CMND_CREATE_MANIP_CHARA(0, _body), and returns the new handle.
Body (kit) number for the new model, e.g. 950.
Handle of the recreated player character.

examples.case: Changing the player character's outfit (real usage, from ev42010100.nut)
